title: Backup and Recovery
description: Plan for data backup and recovery in case of any unforeseen circumstances. This includes both your website's codebase and any user data you might be storing.

title: Maintenance and Updates
description: Websites aren't a 'set it and forget it' type of project. You'll need to plan for regular updates, both to the content and to the underlying software, to keep everything running smoothly and securely.

title: Performance Monitoring
description: Consider using tools to monitor the performance of your website. This can help you catch and fix any issues that might slow down your site or make it less responsive.

title: User Feedback
description: Plan for a way to gather user feedback. This could be as simple as a feedback form on your website, or more complex like user testing sessions.

title: Localization
description: If you plan to serve users in different regions or who speak different languages, you might need to consider localization of your website's content.

title: Legal Considerations
description: Make sure you're aware of any legal requirements for your website, such as GDPR for European users.

title: Budget
description: Ensure that all the services and tools you plan to use fit within your budget, and don't forget to account for ongoing costs like hosting and domain registration.

title: Timeline
description: Make sure you have a realistic timeline for your development plan. Each task should have a specific deadline.
